next_milestone: Add traceable, reproducible evidence for: Integrated product prototype.

security_review.scope: Limited high-confidence text-pattern and file-presence checks; not a full secret scanner, dependency vulnerability audit, licence opinion, branch-ruleset audit or penetration test.

limitations: Confidence is a coverage-derived proxy, not statistical confidence.
Static checks do not replace security alerts, dependency audits, human licence review, threat modelling or penetration testing.
Scores do not increase with elapsed time; evidence credits require deliberate review.
